$Comment: Percent of the knockback the carrier shrugs off when another player hits them, in whole percent points (10 takes a tenth off). It never touches a creature's knockback; KnockbackResist is the stat for every hit. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers or a talent's grant. ziggfreed-common reads it on every hit one player lands on another and holds it at the cap this file's ZigCeiling tag names (50, so a player's hit still moves the carrier; nothing raises it, and a server changes it by shipping this file with another value); it multiplies with KnockbackResist and every other knockback cut. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps, and a total below 0 cuts nothing.
